originalGoal: All ten implementation tickets completed, independently reviewed and committed; post-session mutation is a separate follow-up.
mutationStatus: EFCore execution complete and cleaned; benchmark running at this snapshot; semantic report review pending.

efcore.qualification: Exit zero and killed counts do not approve survivors, uncovered mutants, timeouts or compile errors. No passing mutation adequacy claim.

owners.executionAndCleanup: Task-owned local supervisors and sequential OS controller; preserve logs, reports, immutable base and exact terminal/cleanup receipts.
owners.mechanicalCollection: Task-owned collector analyzes completed JSON reports and writes artifacts/tt-009/mutation/collection-status.json. This is deterministic aggregation, not semantic review.
owners.semanticReview: Codex follow-up: inspect both actual reports, resolve source/test attribution, classify every survivor cluster, uncovered scope, timeout and compile error, then perform scoped verified repairs or create tracked follow-up where warranted.
owners.automationGap: No automatic semantic review or agent wake-up is installed. A subsequent Codex follow-up must consume the retained reports; collection completion alone is not review.

recovery.ownership: Each attempts/<name>/owner.json binds exact container/image/source/output. Inspect live Docker state before recovery; never restart or delete a layer based on a stale status file.

retention: Keep local raw mutation reports/logs/receipts and pinned reusable images until semantic review and evidence extraction. Remove only exact task-owned disposable writable layers; supervisors do so on every terminal path. Preserve unrelated container, stash and shared caches.
